messages:
anne-cs: Heads up — Kyra (healthtech) onboarding: they need a temporary throughput bump for a public demo next Tue. Current steady is ~40rps, ask is 150rps for a 48h window. Also requesting EU region enable + IP allowlist. Can ops/plat support?

devon-ops: Logged. We can apply a temporary rate increase and enable eu-west. Need: org id, route, and exact IP ranges. Any data residency constraints?

anne-cs: Org: kyra-health-prod. Route: /v1/generate (model: redwood-1-large). IPs they provided: ```34.120.0.0/18, 35.200.128.0/18, 3.4.5.0/24``` No special residency contracts, but they prefer EU serving for demo attendees.

sam-support: I'll add those to the tenant allowlist once devon confirms the exact ACL entry format. Also can enable ap-southeast if they want APAC demo later.

maria-plat: For routing: we should pin their tenant to eu variant during the window and set automatic fallback to hosted-us if eu capacity is constrained. I can create a rollout policy: primary=eu-west-1, fallback=us-west-2, threshold errors=5%.

devon-ops: Proposed config applied (will auto-revert after 48h): rate_limit=150 rps, burst=300, window=48h, pinned_region=eu-west-1, fallback_region=us-west-2. ACL entries added as given. Will post deploy confirmation.

anne-cs: Nice — also flagging renewal risk: Kyra mentioned latency and cost as reasons they might shop. We should schedule an enablement with product to show cost/latency tradeoffs and quantization options. Wed 10am PT works for them.

elena-se: I can join the enablement and bring a dashboard: per-route latency by region, token cost breakdown, and suggestions (batching + lower-precision model) to reduce cost. Also capturing customer feedback: they reported occasional hallucinations on medication names — we'll add a short eval for that.

sam-support: Allowlist and region flags pushed. Temporary rate bump is live. Revert scheduled at 1769460456 (48h).

deploy-bot: config change applied by devon-ops at 1769460000 — rate_limit=150rps, regions=[eu-west-1, us-west-2], acl=3 entries.

devon-ops: I also set an alert: if error rate >5% or latency P95 rises >500ms we'll page SRE. I'll follow up with logs retention to 30d for their tenant during the test window.

anne-cs: Great coordination — enablement invite sent to Kyra and product. Will capture post-demo feedback and update renewal risk. :thumbsup:
